The creator is assigned as admin, and an initial 7-day join code is generated and returned securely.

Join a group using a valid, unexpired, and unrevoked join code.
Prevents duplicate active memberships.

Revokes any previously active join codes for this group.

Suggests an expense category for a given description and optional merchant using a 3-layer pipeline (user history -> local ML classifier -> Groq LLM fallback).
Records user confirmation or manual category override. Persists the feedback and updates the user's historical profile for future personalization.
